title: sabline.ceiling/1
description: A ceiling over every budget on a machine: whoever administers the machine installs it, and every budget a run on it is given must sit inside 'allow', or the run is refused before its program is read. sabline-spec SPEC.md section 8.11 defines it. Unlike a predicate, a ceiling holding a field this schema does not define is not a ceiling: a field its reader skipped may be one its writer meant to narrow with.

allow.description: A budget, in the grammar of section 4: the most any run's budget on the machine may grant. Paths are resolved where the run is, so a ceiling should write each one whole.

description.description: For the people who read the file. It changes nothing.
